title: Florida mom buys 480 toilet paper rolls, earns miles for daughter's flight home
summary_full: In an effort to minimize travel costs, Florida resident Michelle Jolene bought toilet paper through an airline shopping website, amassing 8,500 airline miles. These miles allowed her daughter to fly home for Thanksgiving from Washington, D.C. As airfares continue to climb, families face challenges with ticket prices and possible cancellations during the holiday rush. Michelle's inventive method showcases the potential for everyday spending to alleviate travel expenses.
